mapping.draft_py:
# Voracious Hydra (M20). Trample and "enters with X +1/+1 counters" are compiled (keywords; abilities[0] EtBState).
# "When this creature enters, choose one —
#   • Double the number of +1/+1 counters on this creature.
#   • This creature fights target creature you don't control."
# event: ETB of the source (Skeleton Archer / Meteorite B2a ETB shape).
# modes: Elder Gargaroth's Choose(count=QConst(1), options=(...)).
# double: Invigorating Surge's B5b-double-counters-target second step, anchored on this creature:
#         PUT_COUNTER(count=QProp(COUNTER_COUNT) of the creature, +1/+1) on the source (Lorescale Coatl's
#         "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature" selector).
# fight: Brash Taunter's B3-fights-target (the source fights) with Primal Might's "target creature you don't
#        control" filter, exactly one target (QConst(1)).
etb = ZoneChangeEvent(
    from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
    to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
    subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
)
double_counters = A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
    'count': QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.COUNTER_COUNT),
    'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
    'target': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
})
fight = A(Verb.FIGHT, {
    'target': Selector(
        count=QConst(value=1),
        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
        filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU)),
            ),
        ),
        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    ),
})
etb_modal = TriggeredAbility(
    event=etb,
    condition=None,
    effect=Choose(count=QConst(value=1), options=(double_counters, fight)),
)
abilities = [compiled[0], etb_modal, compiled[1]]
